tools.name: rating_meaning
tools.description: Explains what a chess rating (Elo, Chess.com or Lichess) means: whether it is good, where it sits among online players, and a link to the full guide for that level. Use for questions like "is 1200 a good chess rating?"

tools.name: elo_change
tools.description: Calculates how many rating points a player wins or loses for a win, draw and loss against an opponent, using the Elo formula. Also returns the expected score.

tools.name: recent_games
tools.description: Summarizes a player's recent public games on Chess.com or Lichess: wins, draws and losses, rating trend, results by colour, and most played openings. Links to a free Chess DNA analysis of the player's strengths and weaknesses.
